Season met the ocean, and the ocean met him right back 🌊

Season is the bright Yang spirit, and when he touched a giant wave he became Yang Water: the open sea, deep, strong and always moving. Ren Water doesn't trickle. It rolls forward with confidence, carries things a long way and finds a way around anything in its path. In people, it is the big-hearted, adventurous side that loves freedom, thinks big and can take on a lot without losing its flow. Like the tide, real strength can be powerful and calm at the same time.

Who is the ocean in your life, the one who carries everyone along? Tag them below 👇
